title: Nilo jawir tʼaqhisiyat alma
intro: Mä jachʼa tʼaqhesiñ tiemponjja, kunapachatï mä tiranojj jan sinttʼasis marka apnaqkäna ukhajja, mä almaw reyin chuymachtʼatäñat sipansa iyawsäwi thak ajllïna. Aka uñacht’awix ch’aman chuymapan jakasïna ukampis mä alt’at chuyman profetan yatiyawipanx chiqaw sasaw jikxatäna. Jupanakan saräwipajj paciencianïñata, sacrificio lurañata ukat jan pächasis confiyañ toqet mä jan tiemponi yatichäwiruw tukuñapäna. ¿Akapachankir jaqit sipansa Diosan kusisiñap jukʼamp munasir aka muspharkañ jaqir uñtʼasmati?
clues: Wali chʼamani palacionwa jakasiyäta, ukampis chuymajajj altʼat chuyman mä yatiyäwinwa cheqa yatichäwinak jikjjatäna.
Musa chachan irnaqataparjam sarnaqañwa ajlliwayta, kuna jan walinakansa uñjasiristjja uk yatisa.
Nayajj tiempojan wali chʼamani tiranompiw casarasirïta, ukampis kʼari diosanakaparuw apanukuyäta.
Tʼaqesiñajajj wali jachʼänwa, kunattejj mä sapa Diosar creyitajat castigatäpjjayätwa.
Janipuniw iyawsäwijan aynachtʼirïkti, wali tʼaqhesiñampis uñjaskayäta ukhasa.
Tatitujajj paciencianïtajat wal kusisïna, ukatwa Paraison jachʼañchatäñatak ajlliwayitu.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
